title: EncoderPredictor fixed hyperparameters (v0.1.0a9 documentation snapshot)
description: Documentation-owned schema snapshot for top-level pre-inheritance EncoderPredictor hyperparameters in exact release v0.1.0a9. ConvEncoder and RCConvEncoder share the convolutional encoder fragment shape. Not a canonical runtime definition. Runtime also enforces inheritance fill, dilation/fc_hidden_dims prefix rules, even n_channels for RC encoders, n_channels % n_heads == 0, at least one positive head weight, and not freezing every module.

learning_rate.description: Top-level learning rate must be > 0. Nested module rates may be 0 to freeze.
